notes.title: Slime, Fire and Soul big update!
notes.notes:
This update introduces new achievements, enhances gameplay mechanics, and adds some hidden secrets for players to discover. It also includes various bug fixes to improve overall performance and stability.

- more achievements, more grinding
- music and SFX volume slider
- keeps track of the highscore and best speedruns in Normal and Hard modes
- few more items
- minor changes to overall gameplay
- fixed the possibility of soft-locking the run
- added alcoholic beverages
